영어: Scene 1
1. God Called Abraham
One day, God spoke to Abraham.
God said, “Leave your home and go to a new land.”
한글: 하나님께서 말씀하셨어요. “네 집을 떠나 새로운 땅으로 가거라.”

영어:
Abraham listened to God. 
 He did not know where he was going.
한글:
아브라함은 하나님의 말씀을 들었어요. 
 어디로 가야 하는지 알지 못했어요.

영어: But Abraham trusted God.
Scene 2
2. A New Land
Abraham packed his things.
He took his wife Sarah and his nephew Lot.
한글: 아내 사라와 조카 롯도 함께 갔어요.

영어:
They traveled to a new land. 
 They walked for many days.
한글:
그들은 새로운 땅으로 여행을 떠났어요. 
 여러 날 동안 길을 걸었어요.

영어:
Abraham did not know what would happen. 
 But God was with him.
한글:
아브라함은 앞으로 무슨 일이 일어날지 몰랐어요. 
 하지만 하나님께서 아브라함과 함께 계셨어요.

영어: Scene 3
3. God's Great Promise
God gave Abraham a wonderful promise.
God said, “I will make you a great nation.”
한글: 하나님께서 말씀하셨어요. “내가 너를 큰 민족으로 만들겠다.”

영어: “I will bless you.”

Abraham had no children yet. 
 But God promised that his family would become very big.
한글:
아브라함에게는 아직 자녀가 없었어요. 
 하지만 하나님께서는 아브라함의 가족이 아주 많아질 것이라고 약속하셨어요.

영어: Scene 4
4. Abraham Looked at the Stars
One night, God took Abraham outside.
한글: 어느 날 밤, 하나님께서 아브라함을 밖으로 데리고 나가셨어요.

영어: God said, “Look up at the sky.”

Abraham looked at the stars. 
 There were so many stars!
한글:
아브라함은 별들을 바라보았어요. 
 정말 많은 별이 있었어요!

영어: God said, “Your family will be like the stars in the sky.”
한글: 하나님께서 말씀하셨어요. “너의 가족이 하늘의 별처럼 많아질 것이다.”

영어: Scene 5
5. Abraham Trusted God

Abraham was very old. 
 Sarah was also very old.
한글:
아브라함은 나이가 아주 많았어요. 
 사라도 나이가 아주 많았어요.

영어: They still did not have a child.
It seemed impossible.

But Abraham believed God's promise. 
 He trusted God.
한글:
하지만 아브라함은 하나님의 약속을 믿었어요. 
 하나님을 믿었어요.

영어: Abraham waited for God's promise.
Scene 6
6. Isaac Was Born
God did not forget His promise.
God gave Abraham and Sarah a baby boy.
They named him Isaac.
Abraham and Sarah were very happy!
God had kept His promise.
Scene 7
7. God Keeps His Promise
Abraham waited for a long time.
But God kept His promise.
Abraham had a son named Isaac.
God blessed Abraham's family.

Abraham learned something important: 
 God always keeps His promises.
한글:
아브라함은 중요한 것을 배웠어요. 
 하나님께서는 언제나 약속을 지키세요.

영어:
God loves us. 
 We can trust Him!
한글:
하나님께서는 우리를 사랑하세요. 
 우리는 하나님을 믿을 수 있어요!
